limitations: This is reproducible offline implementation/route evidence, not native Ableton acceptance.
The existing strict fake executes every declared operation against adapter test doubles; it does not prove behavior on each Live version.
Python and Max expose different binding conventions. Unsupported, version/edition gates and backend-bound identities remain explicit.
No Live connection, hardware command, audio processing/listening or production Set acceptance is performed by this audit.

legacy_coverage.note: The old inventory remains the pinned identifier/source-hash input. Its historical coverage labels and overrides are superseded by this ledger, not rewritten. Native acceptance remains independent.
legacy_coverage.python_extensions: api/python_extensions.json is outside the official 45/588 denominator and remains separate.

hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 source text with CRLF normalized to LF; no machine paths or timestamps.
